mmBERT Pre-training Data P2
	



[!CAUTION]

	
		
	
	
		🚨 DEPRECATED: KNOWN BUG 🚨
	

This is an old version of the data with a critical bug: token IDs were stored as uint16 and overflow.
mmBERT's vocabulary is larger than 65,535, so any token ID above that limit wraps around and is silently corrupted.
❌ Do NOT use this data for training. This card is kept for reference only (data mixture, sources, and documentation).
✅ Fixed data: orionweller/mmBERT-pretraining-data-chunk0
ℹ️… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/orionweller/mmBERT-pretrain-p2-fineweb2-remaining.
